Account self-service, immutable order details, tracking, cancellation/returns/invoices, policies, inbox/preferences, verified reviews, and clear refund/receipt operations.
SMS, email/storage/payment/shipping provider configuration and fail-safe adapters are implemented; live-provider acceptance remains an owner operation.
Dashboard verify, backend unit/integration, website unit/browser, Flutter analysis/tests/debug APK, isolated restore drill, contract release check, and production dependency audits pass.

Complete Razorpay test/live controlled payments and refunds, Twilio sender approval and real-device OTP acceptance.
Supply Shiprocket credentials and complete the controlled forward and reverse provider acceptance defined in docs/build/SHIPROCKET_ACTIVATION.txt.
Provide Android release signing/Play credentials and iOS signing/team/Mac plus real-device release acceptance.
Establish reviewed remote Git baselines for the currently local backend, website and app sources; local secret and generated-artifact ignores are in place but no source was pushed.
